_note: 學習路徑內容建置第17批 #1／6：情態助動詞 could（eng.t_mid.modal.could，會考級／中階）。could＝can 的過去式，三個用法：過去一般能力（When I was young, I could run fast.）、委婉請求（Could you…?）、現在/未來的可能（It could rain later.）。could 後接原形動詞、不加 to、不加 -s。誘答以『過去誤用現在式 can／could 後誤加 to 或 -s／把委婉請求換成非請求語氣的助動詞』鎖唯一正解；避開『Can/Will you…?』這種同為合法委婉請求的選項。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix cld_）。

units.title_zh: 情態助動詞 could（過去能力／委婉請求／可能）
units.can_do: 我能用 could 表達三種意思：過去的一般能力（When I was young, I could swim.）、委婉的請求（Could you help me?）、以及現在或未來的可能（It could rain later.），並知道 could 後面接原形動詞。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'could' is used to talk about general ability in the past: 'When I was five, I could swim.'
claims.verification_ref: could 表過去一般能力；When I was five, I could swim；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'Could you ...?' makes a request more tentative and polite: 'Could you help me, please?'
claims.verification_ref: Could you…? 為委婉請求；Could you help me, please；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'could' expresses present or future possibility (something is possible but not certain): 'It could rain later.'
claims.verification_ref: could 表現在/未來的可能；It could rain later；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After 'could' we use the base form of the verb (could + V), with no 'to' and no '-s': 'She could swim' (not 'could to swim' / 'could swims').
claims.verification_ref: could 後接原形動詞、不加 to、不加 -s；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: could is the past form of can. It is also used for polite requests and for possibility. First use: for a general ability in the past, use could. When I was young, I could run very fast. After could, use the base form of the verb.
teach.zh_hint: could 是 can 的過去式，也用來委婉請求和表示可能。第一個用法：過去的「一般能力」用 could。When I was young, I could run very fast.（我小時候跑得很快。）could 後面接原形動詞。

teach.body: When I was young, I could run very fast.
teach.zh_hint: 我小時候跑得很快。過去的一般能力用 could。

teach.body: Second use: to make a very polite request, use Could you...? (You can also say Can/Will you...?, but Could sounds more polite.) Could you pass me the salt, please?
teach.zh_hint: 第二個用法：要很有禮貌地請求時，用 Could you…?（也可以用 Can／Will you…?，但 Could 更客氣）。Could you pass me the salt, please?（可以請你把鹽遞給我嗎？）

teach.body: Could you pass me the salt, please?
teach.zh_hint: 可以請你把鹽遞給我嗎？委婉的請求。

teach.body: Third use: could can show present or future possibility (something is possible but not certain). It could rain this afternoon. In all three uses, could is always followed by the base form of the verb.
teach.zh_hint: 第三個用法：could 表示「現在或未來的可能」（有可能、但不確定）。It could rain this afternoon.（下午可能會下雨。）三個用法的 could 後面一律接原形動詞。

teach.body: It could rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
teach.zh_hint: 下午可能會下雨，帶把傘。could 表可能。

practice.stem: 選正確：When I was a child, I ____ climb trees easily.（我小時候可以輕鬆爬樹）

distractor_rationales.can: 句子說 When I was a child（過去），過去的一般能力用 could，不用現在式 can。
distractor_rationales.could to: could 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。
distractor_rationales.am able: am able 是現在式、且 able 後要接 to（am able to climb），與『小時候（過去）』不符。

practice.feedback: 過去的一般能力用 could：When I was a child, I could climb trees。

practice.stem: 選最客氣的請求：____ you open the window, please? It's hot in here.（可以請你開窗嗎？）

distractor_rationales.Did: Did you open…? 是在問『過去有沒有做』，不是請求對方現在做。
distractor_rationales.Should: Should you open…? 是在問『你該不該開』，不是客氣的請求。
distractor_rationales.Must: Must you open…? 帶『你非得…嗎』的語氣，不是客氣的請求。

practice.feedback: 委婉請求用 Could you…?：Could you open the window, please?

practice.stem: 'It could be true, but I'm not sure.' 這句的 could 表示什麼？

distractor_rationales.過去的能力: 這裡講『現在可能是真的』，不是過去的能力。
distractor_rationales.必須: 『必須』是 must；could 表可能，不是必須。

practice.feedback: could 表不確定的可能：It could be true＝可能是真的（但不確定）。

practice.stem: 選正確：My grandpa ____ very well when he was young.（我爺爺年輕時游得很好）

distractor_rationales.could swims: could 後面接原形動詞，不加 -s。
distractor_rationales.could to swim: could 後面接原形動詞，不加 to。
distractor_rationales.could swimming: could 後面用原形動詞 swim，不用 V-ing。

practice.stem: 選正確：Ten years ago, I ____ touch my toes, but now I can't.（十年前我碰得到腳趾，現在不行了）

distractor_rationales.can: 句子說 Ten years ago（過去），過去的能力用 could，不用現在式 can。
distractor_rationales.will: will 表未來，與『十年前』的過去不符。
distractor_rationales.could to: could 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。

practice.feedback: 過去的能力用 could：Ten years ago, I could touch my toes。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Could you help me with my homework?
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：Could you（委婉請求）有沒有寫對、句尾問號有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。請求句 Could you 起、句尾 please 語調上揚；可能句句尾下收。

lines.text: Could you say that again, please?
lines.intonation: Could you 起、please 語調上揚（客氣詢問）

lines.text: I could play the piano when I was six.
lines.intonation: I could play the piano 起、when I was six 句尾下收
